  "text": "Semantic/document inconsistency uses the same evidence-first boundary. First classify whether a capability is actually integrated (`producer -> evaluator -> host consumer -> notice/context surface -> regression`) instead of treating exported code/tests/roadmap checkboxes as runtime adoption. For prose/current-state drift, exact declared identities and deterministic typed claims are authoritative comparison inputs. Similarity/fuzzy/vector retrieval may only find candidate pairs; it must not prove contradiction. Temporal scope, subject identity, authority class and comparable value/revision must agree before deterministic rules can elevate evidence to a proven conflict. Otherwise the system emits bounded review/abstention evidence. This preserves useful heuristics without granting semantic rewrite authority.",
